data.name: Perez
data.gender_notes: Perez is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Perez means 'reward' or 'salvation'. In the Old Testament, Perez was the name of a son born to Judah and Tamar. He was considered a reward for Judah's faithfulness and a sign of redemption after Judah's previous sin. The name Perez carries the meaning “Reward, Salvation” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Perez usually hope their child will grow to embody reward, salvation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sign of redemption, symbol of faithfulness
data.etymology: Perez belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Reward, Salvation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Perez total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Πérez

Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αν και δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, οι ρίζες της ονομασίας αυτής βρίσκονται στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη και σχετίζονται με τον Perez, απόγονο του Ιούδα. in_latin.name: Perez

in_english.name: Perez
in_english.meaning: Perez means 'he who breaks through' or 'gap'
in_english.long_meaning: The name Perez originates from the Hebrew 'פרץ' (Perets), meaning 'he who breaks through' or 'gap'. It is rooted in the biblical account of Perez, the son of Judah, whose name reflects his action of breaking through as the firstborn. Perez is mentioned in the Bible (Genesis 38:29, Ruth 4:12), symbolizing breakthrough and leadership. As a Christian name, Perez signifies strength, pioneering spirit, and a dynamic personality. It has been adopted across various Christian cultures, maintaining its biblical significance and historical roots.

data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Perez holds great spiritual significance. It serves as a reminder of God's blessings and rewards for faithfulness and obedience. The story of Perez in the Old Testament demonstrates how even after experiences of sin and brokenness, God can bring about redemption and new beginnings. Hence, Perez can be seen as a symbol of hope, grace, and salvation.

It is a reminder of God's promise to bless and exalt those who put their trust in Him.
